entities.name: Query CTP synthase
observations: 547 aa; calculated molecular mass 61.5 kDa and theoretical pI 7.97.
Strong homology to reviewed bacterial CTP synthases (64.2–64.6% identity; 97.4–97.6% query coverage).
Likely ATP-dependent UTP amination to CTP; glutamine/ammonia are reference-supported nitrogen sources. Function is inferred from homologs, not direct assay of this sequence.
Reference proteins are described as homotetramers; oligomeric state of this query is not directly established.
Reference annotation reports allosteric activation by GTP for glutamine-dependent activity and feedback inhibition by CTP.

entities.name: UTP to CTP synthesis
observations: Reference reaction: UTP + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O → CTP + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+); Rhea RHEA:26426.
A separate reference reaction permits ammonia as the nitrogen source (Rhea RHEA:16597); exact substrate use by query is inferred.

entities.name: De novo CTP biosynthesis
observations: Close reviewed homologs are annotated in de novo CTP biosynthesis and pyrimidine metabolism; pathway placement for this query is homology-based.
